blocks.html: He confessed also that he was debtor to several persons, whom he names in his hearing, in divers sums of money, quantities of wheat, wine and millet, and moreover in certain quintals of wool, more fully specified therein; requesting that the said creditors be satisfied out of the property that he still has at the place of Le Pin, as much from his late father Arnauld Guilhem du Tilh as from others — now possessed and occupied by Carbon Barrau his maternal uncle, whom, by reason of this, he has already sued.
